assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 法定控制条件未知：道路红线、轨道安全保护区、文保范围与建设控制地带、绿线蓝线、现行控规、土地权属与市政条件均未发布，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径示意，官方数据发布后复算。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory controls are unknown: road redlines, rail safety zones, heritage protection scopes, green/blue lines, current regulatory plans, land ownership and municipal conditions are unpublished; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only and recomputes when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 现状无障碍调查与老年需求基线缺失：本方案仅开展概念级用户旅程与需求方向判断，不声称代表真实需求规模；合法授权并匿名化的调查数据发布后更新。
assumptions.statement_en: No unified-point accessibility survey or elderly-needs baseline exists; this proposal runs concept-level user journeys only and claims no real demand scale; it updates when authorized anonymized survey data is published.

assumptions.statement_zh: 无碍驿、宜老坊与智伴亭三节点均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All node facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 感知与反馈仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，最小必要采集、限期删除，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Sensing and feedback process anonymized aggregates only with human review as backstop, minimal necessary collection and time-limited deletion; no individual identification and no humanly non-terminable automated decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 无障碍体验日、适老生活市集与代际共融季等均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺，正式实施前须依法论证。
assumptions.statement_en: The Accessibility Experience Day, Age-Friendly Living Bazaar and Intergenerational Cohesion Season are design suggestions, not confirmed government arrangements or investment commitments.
